units.prompt: Rebuild IMAGE1 MUMAKIL war-elephant unit in the new consistent crisp PIXEL ART. IMAGE1 controls elephant ANATOMY, original gray/red/gold identity and exact tower/crew composition. IMAGE2 original neutral HUMAN skeleton controls only four MINIATURE HUMAN CREW fivehead bones and overall pixelcluster/outline style, never elephant anatomy. Exactly ONE huge GRAY elephant, ONE long trunk pointing down/front, TWO whole gigantic curved IVORY tusks with GOLD/bronze binding bands, four plausible massive legs and broad toenails, two large ears. Natural elephant proportions from source, no humanoid5head rule for elephant, no mammoth fur. Source RED painted stripes on ears/trunk/forehead are decorative PAINT, not new blood. Gray/bronzegold forehead armor carries RED panel GOLD branch/tree motif. Red/black GOLD-edged saddlecloth with black serpentlike motifs and gold tassels. Tall darkBROWN WOOD howdah/tower on back has intact plank walls, rope joins and GOLD round corner finials, TWO RED vertical side pennants with GOLD tree motifs. Exactly FOUR small adult HARADRIM crew in fitted bronze/silver helmets, red face scarves and brownbronze armor at original tower positions, normal human FIVE-head bones if standing; keep tiny relative to elephant, not giant chibi heads. Simple complete wood bows at rest for visible archers, no extra people/arms. Elevated FRONT slight diagonal looking down30deg, see top of elephant skull/back/shoulders and upper howdah floors, no sideview/verticaltopview. Preserve original whole-unit bodycenter, full trunk/tusk tips/legs/tower/flags within generous clear transparent RGBA margin. Discrete restrained gray/brown/red/gold color ramps, stepped black/dark outlines and pixelclusters like image2/new Gondor; no smooth painted3D fur or photorealtexture. No floor/base/terrain/shadow/smoke/aura/text, no cropped finials/tusks.
